_note: Special NPC behaviours, merged by the server onto npcs.json (key = npc id). Owned by the server agent. Fields: stationary, noAttack, spawns {npc, trigger: attacked|always, delayMs, everyMs, count, max, radius, despawnIdleMs}, escorts {npc, count, radius, despawnIdleMs}, invulnerableWithMinions, regen {hpPerSec, shieldPerSec, afterMs, whileMinions}, assist (radius), slowOnHit {speed, ms}, kamikaze {atHp, delayMs, radius, damage}.
_sources: Cubikon/Protegit: emu-dark Mothership.cs/Daughter.cs (release after 2 s of combat, top up to 20 alive, 5 s cycle, circle mother at 550, despawn after 30 s idle), Flavio007 Cubikon.cs (cap 20, shield repair after 10 s), wiki Cubikon (no attack, heals up to 125,000 HP/s when not attacked; Protegits target top-damage attacker and roam after its death) + wiki Protegit (groups of 20-30). Battleray/Interceptors, Century Falcon/Vagrants, Ice Meteoroid/Icy, Boss Kucurbium escorts + insta-shield, Hitac-Mothership 6 minions + insta-shield, Saboteur slowdown to 200, Barracuda kamikaze at 20% HP after 5 s, Mordon calls other Mordons: darkorbit.fandom.com wiki pages of those aliens + 'Mothership'. Escort counts for Kristallon/Lordakium and kamikaze damage are design choices (not documented).
